title: Red Kangaroo Ka Dhasu Sach! 🦘 #shorts
idea: Exploring the mind-blowing journey of a red kangaroo from a tiny newborn crawling into its pouch to a massive leaping giant.

lines.text: Kya aapko pata hai 60 km/h se bhaagne wala Red Kangaroo kitna ajeeb hai?
Jab iska bachha paida hota hai, toh yeh sirf kuch centimeter lamba hota hai!
Bina aankhon ke yeh bachha ma ke pouch tak 3 se 5 minute mein climb karta hai!
Bada hone par yeh mature male 2.1 meter tak lamba aur 91 kg ka hota hai!
Ye ek hi jump mein 8 se 9 meter lamba chhalaang laga sakta hai!
Kya aapne kabhi itne chhote bachhe ko itna giant bante dekha hai? Comment karo!

facts.claim: Red kangaroos can reach speeds of around 60 km/h.
A newborn red kangaroo is only a few centimeters long.
It takes 3 to 5 minutes for the newborn to climb into the mother's pouch.
Large mature male red kangaroos can stand up to 2.1 meters tall and weigh 91 kg.
Male red kangaroos can cover 8 to 9 meters in a single leap.
